// CASE ts_object_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function loadProfiles(
	ids: string[],
	width: number,
): Promise<Profile[]> {
	const results: Profile[] = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = {
					user: await loadUser(ids[index]),
					orders: await loadOrders(ids[index]),
				};
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_array_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function loadPairs(
	ids: string[],
	width: number,
): Promise<[User, Order[]][]> {
	const results: [User, Order[]][] = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = [
					await loadUser(ids[index]),
					await loadOrders(ids[index]),
				];
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_sum_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function totals(ids: string[], width: number): Promise<number[]> {
	const results: number[] = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = (await paid(ids[index])) + (await owed(ids[index]));
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_call_wrapping_two_awaits expect=fire
export async function merged(ids: string[], width: number): Promise<Merged[]> {
	const results: Merged[] = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = merge(
					await loadUser(ids[index]),
					await loadOrders(ids[index]),
				);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_void_two_awaits_in_call expect=fire
export async function syncAll(ids: string[], width: number): Promise<void> {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				report(await push(ids[index]), await verify(ids[index]));
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE ts_canonical_control expect=pass
export async function canonical(
	ids: string[],
	width: number,
	op: (id: string) => Promise<Profile>,
): Promise<Profile[]> {
	const results: Profile[] = new Array(ids.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < ids.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await op(ids[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
